'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Deir ez-Zor offensive (2024)|Deir ez-Zor offensive]], [[Eastern Syria insurgency]]
***[[Islamic State]] militants launch attacks on the town of al-Hawayej in northeastern [[Syria]], against [[Asayish (North and East Syria)|Asayish]] forces. [https://www.syriahr.com/%d8%ae%d9%84%d8%a7%d9%8a%d8%a7-%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%aa%d9%86%d8%b8%d9%8a%d9%85-%d8%aa%d9%87%d8%a7%d8%ac%d9%85-%d8%ad%d8%a7%d8%ac%d8%b2%d8%a7-%d9%84%d9%80%d8%a7%d9%84%d8%a3%d8%b3%d8%a7%d9%8a%d8%b4/742184/ (SOHR)]
**Protests occur after a [[Christmas tree]] was set on fire in [[Al-Suqaylabiyah]], [[Hama Governorate]], Syria. [https://www.theweek.in/news/middle-east/2024/12/24/watch-videos-syria-christmas-tree-torched-by-islamists-in-christian-town-hts-blames-foreign-fighters-as-protests-erupt.html (''The Week'')]
**[[Turkey]]'s [[Ministry of the Interior (Turkey)|interior minister]] announces that more than 25,000 [[Syrian diaspora|Syrian refugees]] have returned to Syria since former [[President of Syria|president]] [[Bashar al-Assad]] was overthrown by rebels. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2024/12/24/turkey-says-over-25-0000-syrians-returned-home-since-al-assad-s-fall- (Al Arabiya)]
**[[Syrian opposition]] factions announce that they will dissolve and merge under the authority of the [[Ministry of Defense (Syria)|Ministry of Defense]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/syrias-al-sharaa-agrees-with-ex-rebel-factions-merge-under-defence-ministry-2024-12-24/ (Reuters)]
*[[Haitian crisis (2018–present)|Haiti crisis]]
**[[Gang war in Haiti]]
***Three people are killed by gunmen in [[Haiti]] opening fire at the journalists, police and medical staff at the reopening of the [[Port-au-Prince]] General Hospital. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cx2vpdnd2jmo (BBC News)]
*[[2024 Afghanistan–Pakistan skirmishes]]
**At least 46 people are killed in a series of [[airstrike]]s by the [[Pakistan Army]] against alleged [[Pakistani Taliban]] hideouts in [[Paktika Province]], [[Afghanistan]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/25/pakistan-air-strikes-in-afghanistan-spark-taliban-warning-of-retaliation (Al Jazeera)]

'''Arts and culture'''
*[[National symbols of the United States]]
**[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] signs a bill making the [[bald eagle]] the official [[national bird]] of the [[United States]]. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/politics-news/bald-eagle-officially-americas-national-bird-bidens-signature-rcna185380 (NBC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024–25 Australian bushfire season]]
**Residents of the [[Grampians (region)|Grampians region]] of [[Victoria (state)|Victoria]], [[Australia]], evacuate due to [[bushfire]]s, with more than {{conv|41,000|hectare|acre}} already burnt by the bushfires. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c20ezgv89edo (BBC News)]
*[[2024 Lobitos oil spill]]
**Residents of [[Lobitos District|Lobitos]] and [[Cabo Blanco, Peru|Cabo Blanco]], [[Peru]], demonstrate against Peruvian state-owned oil company [[Petroperú|PetroPerú]] following an [[oil spill]] that contaminated six beaches. [https://larepublica.pe/sociedad/2024/12/24/pobladores-de-lobitos-y-cabo-blanco-protesta-luego-que-petroperu-anunciara-que-playas-afectadas-por-fuga-estan-100-limpias-rgns-422016 (''La República'')]
*Twelve people are killed and four others are injured in an explosion at an explosives factory in Kavakli, [[Balıkesir Province]], [[Turkey]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2024/12/24/blast-at-explosives-factory-in-turkiye-kills-12 (Al Jazeera)]
*The [[Russia]]n [[cargo ship]] [[MV Ursa Major|MV ''Ursa Major'']], allegedly used to evacuate military personnel and equipment from [[Russian involvement in the Syrian civil war|Russian bases]] in [[Syria]], sinks in the [[Mediterranean Sea]] off the coast of [[Spain]] following an explosion in the ship's [[engine room]]. The [[Russian Foreign Ministry]] says that 14 of the 16 crew members have been rescued, with the two others missing. [https://www.politico.eu/article/russia-cargo-ship-sinks-off-the-coast-of-spain/ (Politico)]

'''International relations'''
*[[2024 Israeli invasion of Lebanon]], [[Syrian civil war]]
**[[Palestinian insurgency in South Lebanon|Palestinian factions]] turn over their arms to the [[Lebanese Armed Forces|Lebanese army]] and vacate their headquarters in [[Lebanon]]. [https://www.middleeastmonitor.com/20241223-palestine-factions-hand-weapons-to-lebanon-army-vacate-headquarters/ (Middle East Monitor)]
*[[Denmark–United States relations]]
**The [[Government of Denmark|Danish government]] announces an increase in defense spending for [[Greenland]] hours after [[President-elect of the United States|US president-elect]] [[Donald Trump]] repeated his [[Proposals for the United States to purchase Greenland|interest in purchasing Greenland]], although they affirm that the two are unrelated. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/ckgzl19n9eko (BBC News)]
*[[Russia–United States relations]]
**Gene Spector, an [[Russian Americans|American citizen of Russian descent]], is sentenced to 15 years in [[Prisons in Russia|prison]] by a [[Russia|Russian]] [[Judiciary of Russia|court]] for [[American espionage in the Soviet Union and Russian Federation|espionage]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2024/12/24/europe/gene-spector-sentenced-russia-intl/index.html (CNN)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Capital punishment in Saudi Arabia]]
**[[Human rights]] organization [[Reprieve (organisation)|Reprieve]] reports that [[Saudi Arabia]] [[Execution|executed]] 330 people this year. [https://www.firstpost.com/world/saudi-arabia-executes-330-people-in-2024-highest-in-decades-despite-reform-claims-13847331.html (''First Post'')]
*[[2024 Mozambican protests]]
**At least 21 people are killed and 25 others are injured in a series of violent incidents in [[Mozambique]] following the previous day's confirmation by [[Politics of Mozambique|the high court]] of [[Daniel Chapo]] as [[President of Mozambique|the winning presidential candidate]] in [[2024 Mozambican general election|the recent election]]. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/21-dead-mozambique-erupts-violence-after-election-court-117097353 (ABC News)]
*[[Hong Kong]] offers [[Bounty (reward)|bounties]] of [[Hong Kong dollar|HK$]]1 million ([[United States dollar|US$]]128,728) each for six foreign [[Pro-democracy camp (Hong Kong)|pro-democracy]] activists accused of violating the [[2020 Hong Kong national security law|national security law]], including [[Tony Chung]], and also revokes the [[Hong Kong Special Administrative Region passport|passports]] of seven others, citing actions such as [[incitement]] to [[secession]], [[subversion]], and [[collusion]] with foreign forces. [https://www.reuters.com/world/china/hong-kong-offers-bounties-six-more-democrats-security-squeeze-2024-12-24/ (Reuters)]
*Five people accused of being [[Al-Qaeda]] supporters are arrested in four cities in [[Italy]]. [https://www.ilgazzettino.it/AMP/nordest/terrorismo_giovani_promuovono_al_qaeda-8558136.html (''Il Gazzettino'')]
*Four participants in the [[November 2024 Amsterdam riots]] are sentenced to prison, with 32-year-old Sefa Ö handed the longest sentence of six months. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cwy81qvn7gjo (BBC News)]
*A [[Belarus]]ian court sentences [[Belarusian opposition|opposition]] activist and [[Belarusian Green Party|Green Party]] leader Dzmitry Kuchuk to six years in prison and fines him approximately US$6,000 for alleged [[Public-order crime|public order violations]] and calls for actions undermining national security, according to the [[Human rights in Belarus|human rights]] group [[Viasna Human Rights Centre|Viasna]]. [https://apnews.com/article/belarus-crackdown-dzmitry-kuchuk-prison-lukashenko-elections-b6db153187cd30e7aafdf33acab2a768 (AP)]

*[[ʻAisake Eke]] is appointed as the new [[Prime Minister of Tonga]]. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/537531/aisake-eke-is-tonga-s-new-prime-minister (RNZ)]
